#flux: --time-limit=30m

# Performance consideration: Fine-grained CPU/GPU binding and packing options not preserved.
# You may need to adjust Flux resource allocation and binding at submission time.

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=168
flux run -N ${nnds} -n ${nnds} -c 42 ../amg2013 -laplace -P 16 16 16 -n 100 100 100  > out.txt
flux run -N ${nnds} -n ${nnds} -c 42 ../amg2013 -laplace -P 16 16 16 -n 100 100 100  > out2.txt

"
